criteria.criterion: Never compare gross to net or non-comparable periods
Only average three matched payslips per borrower; no double-counted months
Escalate if abs(declared_net - three_month_net_mean) > 1000 ILS (TEST threshold)
Explanation is not confirmed evidence of income received; refer to banker

verdict_policy: Discrepancy triggers BANKER_REVIEW, not invalid document or credit refusal.
